data.body:
RCA / disposition:
- Root cause: `failover` existed only as a planned overlay concept; code-review overlay dispatch is not derived from routing alone. Without entries in `code-review.yaml`, registry/routing changes would never invoke a failover reviewer, so fallback/retry/error-classification diffs could mask the original retryability/disposition without advisory review coverage.
- RED: focused tests failed before implementation for the missing closed-set entry, missing advisory routing, missing committed-token activation, and missing round_a/round_b dispatch.
- Fix: added advisory `failover` routing and closed-vocabulary registration, packaged token scanning, base prompt catalog entry, explicit round_a/round_b dispatch, reviewer prompt, eval spec, and structural/unit coverage.
- Verification: focused overlay suite passed (`35 passed`); `make lint` passed; full local `make verify` passed with `GIT_CONFIG_*` unset. Initial Gerrit submit found a criteria-routing rebase conflict after another merge; rebased and repushed patchset 2. Gerrit 2935 passed LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1 and was submitted/merged.

Gerrit change: 2935, merged.
Close class: normal completion.
